entities.name: Hybrid mana
entities.description: A type of mana first seen in Ravnica: City of Guilds, where each hybrid symbol represents a cost payable with one of two colors.

entities.name: Two-brid mana
entities.description: Monocolored hybrid mana introduced in Shadowmoor, payable with one color or two generic mana.

entities.name: Phyrexian hybrid mana
entities.description: Hybrid mana introduced in Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty that can be paid in one of two colors or with 2 life.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where hybrid mana was introduced as part of a multicolor theme and to which later sets returned.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The plane whose block used hybrid as its major mechanic and introduced monocolored hybrid.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane of the Alara Reborn set, where hybrid made three-colored cards easier to play.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane of Tarkir: Dragonstorm, where two-brid saw full mechanical implementation on wedge-colored cards.

entities.name: Devin Low
entities.description: A designer who proposed two-brid mana for Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Mark Rosewater
entities.description: A designer who explained that monocolored hybrid cards are not considered color breaks.

entities.name: Compleated
entities.description: A mechanic on planeswalkers associated with Phyrexian hybrid mana costs.

events.summary: Hybrid mana is introduced in the Ravnica block as part of the multicolor theme.
events.quote: Hybrid mana was introduced in Ravnica block as part of the multicolor theme.

events.summary: The Extort mechanic in Gatecrash is the first time a hybrid mana cost was integrated into the rules of a mechanic.

events.summary: The Shadowmoor block uses hybrid as its major mechanic, to the point that R&D realizes it overstretched the design space.
events.quote: Shadowmoor block used hybrid as the major mechanic

events.summary: Hybrid appears in Alara Reborn as an easier way to play three-colored cards.
events.quote: as an easier way to play three-colored cards

events.summary: Shadowmoor introduces monocolored hybrid cards, called two-brid.

events.summary: Modern Horizons 3 introduces monocolored hybrid symbols whose non-color half is colorless mana.
events.quote: Wizards of the Coast introduced a new set of monocolored hybrid symbols where the non-color half is colorless mana.

events.summary: Phyrexian hybrid mana is introduced in Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty.
events.quote: Phyrexian hybrid mana was introduced in Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty .

events.summary: Tarkir: Dragonstorm brings full mechanical implementation of two-brid to lighten wedge-colored cards' mana requirements.
events.quote: to lighten the mana requirements of some of its wedge -colored cards

events.summary: In 2026 hybrid mana crosses from deciduous to evergreen.
events.quote: In 2026, Hybrid mana crossed the barrier from being deciduous to evergreen
